snapshot_note: Read-only snapshot, republished after each successful refresh. Built only from predictions saved before racing.

engine.release_note: v2.1 (25 Nov 2026, 12:17pm): Queensland ratings use the v3 rating, which expects lightly raced horses to improve (research/batch9 A; approved by Damo). NSW/Vic/ACT unchanged. v2.0.2 (12:06pm): win chances use the bent-line calibration. v2.0.1 (11:11am): Queensland scorer fix.
engine.previous: Engine v1 (still scored alongside for monitoring)
engine.scale: Ratings are kg-equivalent: model score divided by the score that 1 kg of opposition-aware rating is worth on average (Qld 0.224, NSW/Vic 0.226 per kg). They are relative to the average runner in the race. Contributions use the same divisor and add up to the rating.

rules: A selection is the top-rated runner in the latest prediction saved before the race starts. It is frozen at that point and never re-created after the race.

The quoted price is the last price captured from a named source at or before 5 minutes before the scheduled start, stored with its source and time. TAB fixed odds and Betfair exchange prices are kept separate and never mixed.
Paper return: 1 unit to win at the quoted price. Selections with no quoted price are listed but excluded from paper returns (and counted).

Scratchings: a scratched selection is void (stake returned). Late-scratching deductions on fixed-odds winners are applied as published by the bookmaker; on Betfair, the exchange reduction factor is applied.
Betfair returns are shown after commission on net winnings, at the rate recorded with the quote.
Realised returns are only bets you actually placed and record yourself. They are never mixed with paper returns. Nothing here places bets.
roi.definitions: OPEN = TAB fixed price at the 7:30am run. CLOSE = final TAB fixed price in the completed racecard (missing if not shown). Paper returns at OPEN, 1 unit. No late-scratching deductions applied (TAB does not publish them in the racecard). Quoted prices are not bets placed.

results.message: Results and final TAB fixed prices were captured on the evening of 25 Nov; every top pick is settled in the returns view (OPEN = 7:30am TAB fixed price). The side-by-side evaluation page is not built yet. One day proves nothing.

operations.item: Ipswich re-issued 12:18pm on Engine v2.1 (new Queensland rating)
operations.note: Approved by you at 12:09pm, before Ipswich race 1 (1:02pm). Queensland ratings now use the v3 rating, which expects lightly raced horses to keep improving. On 2025-26 (re-used data) it beat v2.0 by 0.005 per race (2026: 0.007). Today the top pick is unchanged in all 7 Ipswich races; chances moved by up to 4 points. The 7:56am and 11:11am sets are kept on file. NSW/Vic unchanged.

operations.item: Win chances re-calibrated 12:06pm (Engine v2.0.2, display only)
operations.note: Approved by you at 12:05pm, before any race today. Shown win chances now use the bent-line calibration, which on unseen 2026 races showed top chances close to what they won (Qld 43.5% shown vs 43.0% won; previously 52.7%). Ratings, rankings, selections and paper returns are unchanged. Selection-strength labels use the matching new thresholds.

Ipswich = 11:11am re-issue; Geelong = 7:00am set and Wyong = 6:35am set, both after final scratchings (unchanged by the fix). Strathalbyn, Albany and Launceston are fields only (no history yet). File checksums: prospective/frozen/20261125/FREEZE.json in the repository. No ratings change after this point.

The 7:56am Ipswich set gave the national ability rating zero weight (a scoring fault). Re-scored at 11:11am on the same fields with the fault fixed; the top pick changed in 5 of 7 races. The 7:56am set is kept on file. Paper returns use the 7:30 TAB fixed prices (OPEN) for the re-issued picks; no new price was collected.
